title: One Piece Movie 02: Nejimaki-jima no Daibouken
description: Informed by the Thief Brothers his ship has been stolen by the Trump Kyoudai (Trump Siblings) who have set up base on Clockwork Island. Monkey D. Luffy, Captain of the Going Merry and aspiring Pirate King works with his crew – Usopp, Zoro, Sanji and Nami to battle their way up Clockwork Island to reclaim their ship. (Source: ANN)
